mainEntity.name: Why does common application errors matter at the mistakes stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because clients usually need the topic translated into practical terms before they can decide what to do with it. Before the next step, common application errors usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does documentation issues matter at the mistakes stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because Brazil immigration work usually turns on how well the documents support the facts, not only on whether a person believes they qualify. Before the next step, documentation issues usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.

mainEntity.name: Why does incorrect visa or residency selection matter at the mistakes stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because the route has to match the client's real objective, present status, and supporting facts before any serious next step is taken. Before the next step, incorrect visa or residency selection usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
